This record exists ONLY to feed the atom_gvars manifest (guard_gvars 10, 369) so the brain can perceive the trial state and the arroyo_cameron_pass gate_pass atom's durable guard works. status=DRAFT: get()->None, so it never drives a journal prompt; the atom's own offer_brief grounds the reply. name: Храм испытаний — мирный проход мимо Кэмерона (не журнальный гейт)
_maps_note: Map 003 = ARCAVES (Temple of Trials caves) — Cameron stands at the exit door (scenery pid 934). Map 004 (ARVILLAG) carries a second Cameron instance. No scripted teleport in this gate.

npcs._giver_note: actemvil = Cameron (ACTemVil.int), the final unarmed-combat challenge of the Temple of Trials. The 'giver' framing is nominal — this is a gate, not a journal quest.

brief: Кэмерон — последний страж Храма испытаний. Мирный проход мимо него = уговорить не драться (проверка Красноречия), тогда он отпирает дверь и отходит сам. Это финал испытания, не журнальный квест — записи в Пип-Бое нет.

stages._src: gvar 10 == 0: the trial is unresolved (neither by combat nor by talking). Cameron offers a fight; the peaceful path is to talk him out of it.
combat_p_proc W(10,1) — the fight has started / is under way. Not the finale: the player is still fighting (or won it unarmed).
Node015a @0x3848 W(10,2) — passed by WORD (the peaceful outcome). The door is unlocked by the critter_p_proc heartbeat on LVAR13==2.

_guard_gvars_note: gvar 10 = GVAR_START_ARROYO_TRIAL (0=unresolved, 1=combat, 2=peaceful pass). gvar 369 = 'Cameron is dead' (destroy_p_proc W369,1, alongside W7,1=GVAR_ENEMY_ARROYO). Both emitted so the arroyo_cameron_pass atom's durable guard 'gvar(10)==0 AND gvar(369)==0' works: the atom fires ONLY while the trial is unresolved AND Cameron is alive — never overwriting a combat outcome (10=1) with the peaceful value (10=2), and never firing at a dead Cameron.

completion.condition: The peaceful pass is the ONLY brain-reachable outcome, gated by a REAL engine Speech roll. The arroyo_cameron_pass atom (intent gate_pass, check=Speech) fires exec_proc actemvil:Node015a ONLY on a successful roll (freedlg_turn.cc applies the deferred fx on success); Node015a sets LVAR12=1, LVAR13=2, MVAR20=2, GVAR10=2. The engine then opens the door via the vanilla critter_p_proc heartbeat (LVAR13==2 -> obj_unlock 0x812F + obj_open 0x8131 on scenery pid 934) and walks Cameron away. The brain never writes gvar 10 (setgvar rejects it — 10 is not in quests.txt); the outcome is proc-form + engine-rolled. Combat completion (10=1) and Cameron's death (369=1) are engine-owned and lock the guard.
completion.sets: gvar 10=2 (peaceful pass, via Node015a) | 10=1 (combat, engine) | 369=1 (Cameron killed, engine)
completion.code_ref: ACTemVil.int disasm: Node015 @0x378a roll_vs_skill(dude,14=Speech,0) OR metarule(40,14)=is_skill_tagged(Speech) -> success {169} option {171} -> Node015a @0x3848 (W local 12=1, W local 13=2, W map 20=2, W global 10=2; NO gsay/giq/gdialog opcodes, byte-scan 0x3848..0x389a); critter_p_proc reads LVAR13==2 -> 0x812F obj_unlock + 0x8131 obj_open on pid 33555366=0x20003A6 (scenery 934), walks Cameron via tiles 19728/22712/28715; combat_p_proc W(10,1); destroy_p_proc W(369,1)+W(7,1)+W(10,1). opcodes 0x80C2 opSetLocalVar / 0x80C4 opSetMapVar / 0x80C6 opSetGlobalVar.

reward.xp_source: NONE — Node015a contains no give_exp_points (byte-scan). The peaceful pass grants no XP/items/journal entry; it is the trial finale, not a rewarded quest.
reward.notes: No reward. anti-invention: never promise XP/items for the pass.

anti_invention: The brain must NEVER write gvar 10 — Node015a (peaceful, W10=2), combat_p_proc (W10=1) and destroy_p_proc (W10=1) are the only writers, all engine-side. The atom calls Node015a via exec_proc; it never replicates the writes.
The Speech check is a REAL engine roll (freeActionResolveCheck) — the model must not narrate a pass on a failed roll; the fail_line is voiced instead.
gvar 369 positional name in VAULT13.GAM is 'GVAR_DUMAR_STATUS' but its ACTUAL use here is 'Cameron killed' (destroy_p_proc writer) — trust the NUMBER, not the enum name.
The door is opened by the vanilla heartbeat, NOT by the atom — the atom only sets LVAR13=2 (via Node015a); the brain touches no scenery.
